The Lagos State Police Command has arrested a 24-year-old man, Lukman Sanni, suspected of conveying illegal firearms during a stop-and-search operation at Iyana Isashi, Lagos State. The command disclosed this in a statement issued on Tuesday by its Police Public Relations Officer, Abimbola Adebisi. Adebisi said the arrest was part of the command’s efforts to combat illegal possession and trafficking of firearms, as well as other criminal activities across the state. The police said a search conducted on Sanni led to the recovery of a locally made pistol, two live cartridges and a suspected charm. “Preliminary investigations are ongoing to establish the circumstances surrounding the possession and intended delivery of the recovered firearm and ammunition. The commissioner also urged residents to remain vigilant and promptly report suspicious activities to the police. “Credible information from the public remains vital to maintaining peace and security,” the statement read. The command provided emergency lines for residents to report suspicious activities and emergencies: 07061019374, 08065154338, 08063299264, 08039344870, 08080193432 (Marine) and 09168630929.
